title: Time Flies When You Parallelise: Pareto-efficient Time Series Foundation Models with Linear Recurrences
abstract: arXiv:2611.16934v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time series foundation models have demonstrated strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but computational efficiency remains a central architectural challenge. Temporal self-attention incurs quadratic cost in the number of temporal tokens, while nonlinear recurrent state transitions restrict parallel computation along the temporal dimension. We introduce ci-proto, a family of time series foundation models based on Mamba-3, whose linear state recurrences support chunk-wise parallel-in-time computation during training, and inference costs that scale linearly with sequence length. The architecture alternates recurrent temporal processing with cross-variate attention, supporting multivariate probabilistic forecasting with past-only and future-known covariates. translated_title: 并行化让时间飞逝：基于线性递归的帕累托高效时间序列基础模型
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型已经展现出强大的零样本预测性能，但计算效率仍然是其架构上的核心挑战。时间维度上的自注意力机制会随时间词元数量的增加而产生二次方成本，而非线性的递归状态转移则限制了沿时间维度的并行计算。我们提出了 ci-proto，这是一个基于 Mamba-3 的时间序列基础模型家族，其线性状态递归支持训练时按块的时间并行计算，且推理成本随序列长度线性扩展。该架构将递归式时间处理与跨变量注意力交替使用，支持结合仅历史可见协变量与未来已知协变量的多变量概率预测。在 fev-bench 的 100 项预测任务上，ci-proto XL 在时间序列基础模型中树立了新的最先进水平，五个 ci-proto 变体也共同构成了完整的帕累托前沿。
tldr: 提出基于 Mamba-3 线性递归的时间序列基础模型家族 ci-proto，实现训练时的时间并行与线性推理成本，在 fev-bench 100 项预测任务上创下新的最先进纪录，并凭借五个变体覆盖完整的精度-效率帕累托前沿。
en_tdlr: ci-proto, a family of time series foundation models built on Mamba-3's linear recurrences, enables chunk-wise parallel-in-time training and linear-cost inference, setting a new state of the art on fev-bench's 100 forecasting tasks while spanning the entire accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier.
